name: @tn4consulting/shared-i18n
description: useLocale()/useTranslations() -- React hooks for cross-remote locale sync and {{param}}-interpolated UI-chrome translation, replacing the old provideMfeTransloco()/Transloco-based API. Major-version bump from 0.x: this is a full API replacement, not a compatible extension -- see the family's React-only migration. The last 0.x version remains published for any app repo still consuming the Angular/Transloco-based API.
